lines.en: You stop, and I stop too.
Wherever you go, I head there too.
The carpet swallows my footsteps.
I've come through that stand of trees.
I'm always just outside your sight.
I pause, then keep following.
I keep neither near nor far.
I go around that little house.
You stop at the door; so do I.
I've inched a little closer.
I've slipped back into the shade.
I follow the light you carry.
Only a wall separates us.
I'm behind you, very quiet.
You can turn and still not see me.
I simply stand and watch.
I've waited a long time, unmoving.
The light at night is thin.
I'm hidden behind a tree.
I cast no shadow at all.
I won't move before you sleep.
There's a faint sound inside.
When the wind rose, I turned my head.
There's time before dawn.
I stand in the dark outside your window.
If you hear me, don't open your eyes.
Don't scream when you open your eyes.
Don't move, and don't speak.
Closing your eyes won't help. I'm still here.
Your eyes need to close.
I've been standing here a while.
Your hand reached out and found nothing.

lines.zh: 你闭眼的时候，我就在旁边。
lines.en: When you close your eyes, I'm beside you.
Listen — it's gone quiet outside.
You shouldn't have looked this way.
I've been here since you walked in.
You still have time to shut your eyes.
I step back, very quietly.
This body has been opened.
There's no blood in me.
I dip my head slightly.
You won't want to look again.
I steady myself again.
The broken place is very dark.
I made no sound at all.
I drifted back a little.
I'm still behind you.
I don't need what you carry.
Only the living eat that.
Holding it up changes nothing.
It isn't that I want.
Set it down on the ground.
That's a clever thing to try.
And yet I'm not looking at it.

lines.zh: 我等的不是这样的时刻。
lines.en: This isn't the moment I'm waiting for.
You shouldn't lose focus.
I'll come closer while you're distracted.
It's better with your hands free.
That little thing won't hold me back.
You shouldn't look down right now.

lines.zh: 你转过身后就看不见我。
lines.en: Turn around and you'll lose me.
I'm at your back.
Don't let your hand drop.
You bumped me and froze.
I'm cold — very cold.
Your hand shook as you pulled away.
I gave nothing at all.
That contact was too close.
I've moved back a little.
You turn and I'm over there.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到了我的胸口。
lines.en: Your shoulder touched my chest.
You'd best not touch me again.
The empty spot by the bed is mine alone.
I'm only following you, that's all.
Standing further off is better.
You and I are both too quiet.
There's something between us.
Don't come closer — truly.
I won't leave you.
Standing against the wall like this is fine.
Listen — it's empty all around.
I won't speak; neither should you.
I pick up a small thing.
I let it return to its place.
You dropped it on the ground.
It's very cold in my hand.
I left nothing behind.
It grew indistinct in my hand.
None of this is of use to me.

lines.zh: 你掉下的东西，我会替你收好。
lines.en: What you dropped — I'll keep it safe for you.
You've turned around.
I've waited too long for this moment.
Your back is to the wall.
Without a sound, I come closer.
The door behind you is shut.
You've backed into the corner.
I won't make a sound.
Three inches are all that part us.
I'm right at your bedside.
Your breathing is slowing.
I listen to you turn over.
The wind outside has stopped.
I'm standing in the shadow.
You're frowning in your sleep.
You're about to forget me.
I bend down over you.
One more breath of waiting.
In this very instant.
I've seized your wrist.
I've pinned your hand down.
That was light, and very cold.
You didn't cry out.
My fingers close very tightly.
You tried to pull free and slipped.
I hold you where you are.
You've shut your eyes.
You can't move anymore.
I appear outside your house.
The night is still thick.

lines.zh: 我走起来没有一点声音。
lines.en: I move without making a sound.
Light shows through the window.
I begin moving toward you.
I pace before your door.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有一点声响。
lines.en: I land without a whisper of noise.
Wood creaks inside the house.

lines.zh: 闭上眼睛，你就听不见我。
lines.en: Close your eyes and you can't hear me.
I begin learning your habits.
I'll keep following you.
The firelight forced me back a step.
I fell and rose again.
Water made me heavy.
The blast scattered me.
That light left me nowhere to hide.
I no longer need to eat.
A flash shone right through me.
I fell into a deep black.
